issue_request: FHIR-20841 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for FHIR-core StructureMap and the FHIR Mapping Language. It requested changing StructureMap.group.rule.source.defaultValue[x] from a polymorphic value to a single string holding the embedded FHIRPath expression, and resolving mapping-language ambiguity by requiring parentheses around embedded FHIRPath expressions such as default values, where, check, and log.
initial_application: The change was applied by commit 53e50e29332ff33bf433b294bb5d3bc1717f76ba, which updated mapping-language prose, images/mapping.g4, and the then-current StructureMap spreadsheet source. After source tooling changed, commit 7ce61e3bb680a17f7e4777211028c126e553b17a explicitly re-applied FHIR#20841 to source/structuremap/structuredefinition-StructureMap.xml by replacing defaultValue[x] datatype choices with defaultValue string.
additional_context: StructureMap is active in source/fhir.ini and mapping-language.html is linked from source/hierarchy.xml; the latest combined branch contains the expected StructureMap XML, mapping-language prose, and linked ANTLR grammar. Later FHIR-57220 asked to broaden defaultValue again but was Resolved - No Change/Retracted, and FHIR-20844 from the same StructureMap batch concerns a different target parameter value[x] element already audited separately.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The audit commit records that the current build-linked source already satisfies the issue: source.defaultValue is not a choice element, its only type is string, and default/where/check/log embedded FHIRPath syntax is parenthesized in the mapping-language documentation and grammar.
